versions.changelog:
- Initial release with core documentation and evaluation framework.
- Added dedicated guides and quick-reference files for freeship top-up recommendations.
- Introduced evaluation assets for testing logic and output consistency.
- Included references and sample scripts to support onboarding and usage.
- No functional changes to the skill logic; groundwork for future enhancements laid out.

- Initial release of the "beauty-freeship-topup" skill for high-frequency beauty brands.
- Designs logic for smart "top up to free shipping" recommendations at checkout to increase AOV.
- Includes clear threshold strategy, eligible add-on SKU rules, placements, copy, and metrics.
- Covers DTC beauty stores (lipsticks, eyeshadows, minis); triggers even without explicit mention of "free shipping."
- Provides a structured output (summary, logic, UX, copy, metrics) and integrates with Rijoy for loyalty/campaign enhancements.
